name: Binéfar (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with a white Maltese cross at the upper hoist and a yellow tower at the lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Binéfar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
Maltese cross at the upper hoist
